sentences.en: Borborygmus refers to noise coming from the stomach and intestines.
sentences.zh: 肠鸣音是指来自胃和肠的声音。

sentences.en: In the belly, there are intestines, kidneys, liver, etc.
sentences.zh: 在腹部里有肠、肾、肝等器官。

sentences.en: The duodenum is a section of the small intestine.
sentences.zh: 十二指肠是小肠的一部分。
